title: Three-compartment parts tray (IR v1)
prompt: Parts tray: 128 x 80 mm outside, 25 mm tall, 2 mm floor, 2 mm outer walls, and two 2 mm thick divider walls across the short direction splitting it into three equal 40 mm compartments. Corner at the origin, Z up, long side along X.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
One printable part (walls, floor and dividers joined)
21 flat faces: the outside, the rim, and three open compartments
Dividers at x = 42–44 and 84–86 (equal 40 mm compartments): centroid on the tray's centre lines

notes: IR v1 rewrite of t2-parts-tray: shell (open top) plus a joined divider sketch, one body. 128·80·25 − 3·40·76·23 = 46240. A divider 2 mm off moves the centroid x by 0.15 mm.
